featured_reviews.name: Naman Rawal
featured_reviews.review_text: I am relatively new to the gym, been there about a month now and i have to say it is frankly an amazing experience here! Most of the comments here are about the owner being rude..but it's okay as she is a good person and really you just interact with the trainers on a daily basis..the trainers are really amazing here especially Yogesh and Yatin sir..all three of them in fact. They are always highly helpful and the overall ambience of the gym is very decent and being a small gym, it doesn't really feel like one as there is a lot of equipment here! Overall, love the experience and the trainers are truly the best and i definitely recommend giving this place a try..trust me you'll feel right at home!!

featured_reviews.name: Adil Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely pathetic gym experience. The gym is always overcrowded with no proper management or trainers available to guide members. Washrooms are dirty, equipment maintenance is extremely poor, and half of the machines are constantly out of service.

The staff at the reception, especially Mr. Adnan, is very rude and completely unfriendly towards customers. Before taking the membership, they make a lot of promises, but once the payment is done, none of those promises are fulfilled.

The crowd is so bad that you literally have to wait 15–20 minutes just to use a machine. Overall, a very disappointing experience and definitely not worth the membership fee. I would not recommend this gym at all.

featured_reviews.name: Yadnesh Potdar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointed with the way this gym has handled its renovation closure.
The gym has been shut for over 3 months for relocation purposes, yet there has been little to no communication from management regarding proper reopening timelines, membership extensions, pauses, or refund options. Every update seems to be delayed, and im given new dates about when new facility will actually open. Upon visiting the Tardeo branch for inquiry i am being told to check if the branch is open after few days as if the only job i have is to keep checking when will they open myself.
Super unprofessional and unpleasant behaviour from the staff and lack of transparency. Would not recommend, even local gyms have better customer support than this.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text: When I say you're better off being literally at any other gym over this one, believe me. It's run by a bunch of goons who have no way of speaking to their clients, unless it's about pestering you to renew your membership. At admission they'll promise a whole bunch of services, all to no avail when you've actually paid up. Dirty washrooms, unmaintained equipment and purely money oriented trainers. Do yourself a favour and avoid this one. Literally a week after collecting payment they shut down their Tardeo branch without any prior intimation inspire of being well aware of the situation. Can get far better gyms at the premium rate they try to exploit people with.

featured_reviews.name: Parth Barot
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is my 2nd year in the same gym and writing this review

Overall gym is fine but there are few places where they need to improve first of all machines are not maintained at all if i say at all they are really not working i mean treadmill works but the incline doesn't work, also you get shocks on treadmill handles...cycle works but the calories & time monitor doesn't work, seats on cycle and benches are imbalance they move while you are working out on it, there are no kilo or Lbs sticker or tags on machine weight, pins for machines are always missing.
People are really keen to take your membership they will call you 10 times and make sure you buy membership but once you join no one is there to take a note on your problems or to guide... Also If we talk about guidance i am not asking for any trainer to make you train but atleast keep one attendee on each floor who is APPROACHABLE for any small things like speaker not working or ac not working etc, people who work there are not polite, not genuine, it always feels they are just not interested in anything.
Overall space is good
Gym equipments are really good (if they maintain properly)
Crowd is also good

I hope they view the comment and improve 🙏.

He was kind enough to machine-knock both bats for us at no extra cost, which was really appreciated. The shop is fully stocked with a wide range of sports equipment and accessories—cricket, football, tennis, badminton, paddle sports, and more.

I would highly recommend Galaxy Sports Shop for all your sporting needs in Mumbai.

The trainers are exceptionally supportive and knowledgeable, providing guidance and assistance whenever required. There is no pressure or sales push regarding protein supplements, allowing members to focus purely on their fitness goals. The facility is well-maintained, clean, and hygienic — a crucial aspect for any fitness enthusiast. From an equipment standpoint, the gym is impressively equipped with both modern machines and traditional workout gear, catering to a wide range of fitness preferences. Additionally, there is also an open workout space which adds versatility to training options. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced fitness enthusiast, this gym provides a welcoming atmosphere without being intimidating or overwhelming. In terms of pricing, the membership fees are quite economic.

featured_reviews.name: Shaziya Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
An Exceptional Leg Day training with Nomaan Mukri at Plus Fitness Gym

I had a leg day session with Nomaan at Plus Fitness, and I am absolutely impressed by the quality of the training. I can't recommend him enough to anyone serious about making real progress.
The session began with a comprehensive 30-minute warm-up. I'll be honest, I never realised how much of a difference a proper warm-up could make until today. Nomaan's approach made my muscles feel activated and ready, which completely changed the effectiveness of the entire workout.
When we got into the main leg exercises, Nomaan's expertise was immediately apparent. He guided me through multiple variations and masterfully showed how a small change in angle or form could target a completely different part of the muscle. It was a lesson in anatomy as much as it was a workout! He has a gift for pushing you beyond your comfort zone in the most encouraging way. With his guidance, I was able to safely increase both my repetitions and the weight, achieving more than I thought I was capable of.
Throughout the session, Nomaan shared invaluable knowledge about how to stabilise progress and ensure long-term gains. It's clear he is incredibly well-versed in how different bodies should be trained, considering factors like gender, age, and overall health to create a truly personalised experience.
We finished with a fantastic stretching session that left me feeling strong and mobile, not just exhausted. What truly sets Nomaan apart is his professionalism combined with a genuinely humble and supportive attitude. He makes you feel like a teammate on your fitness journey.
If you want a trainer who is not just a rep-counter but a true teacher and motivator, you must train with Nomaan. My perspective on training has completely changed for the better!

featured_reviews.name: kanupriya kejriwal
featured_reviews.review_text: I love this gym! The concept of workout eluded me before I joined OTF a year back. Now, unless I’ve gone to OTF about 4-5 times a week, I don’t feel my week is complete. I have seen a lot of changes in my body here and I truly love it. Shout out to coach Sherlock, coach Ritika, coach Maahir, coach Marwan. They are all so so good in their own unique way. The admin, support staff, all are extremely helpful and encouraging - be it Samik, Ragini or Sheetal. You won’t regret your decision to join this gym!

featured_reviews.name: Alisha Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text: Orange theory, Marine Drive has been my new favourite gym. The energy levels are high. The music is pumping, and the vibe is fantastic. Coach Maahir, coach. Ritika, and coach Sherlock are amazing, always pushing you. Samik (manager) is super supportive. I've seen a great transformation in the past year that I have been a member here. They provide excellent guidance on weight loss, and if you want to see transformation, this is a place to go!

featured_reviews.name: Vidhika Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great workout experience! Coach Sherlock was amazing and super helpful. His instructions were clear which helped me improve form and increase the burn from the exercise 🤩 [4/5 stars for the coaching]

However please note, the first class is NOT free if :
1. You’re not a permanent resident of India
2. You booked through the phone (we couldn’t load our credit card details online so we got a call from them to book it through the phone)
It’s a chargeable class of Rs. 2,500. [1/5 stars for the admin]

featured_reviews.name: Raika Gazder
featured_reviews.review_text: I’m very happy with OTF, Samik Pal has been supportive, Kind and polite. Recommend to everyone. Ragini convinced me to join, Mahir, Ritika, Sherlock, Marwan are all very encouraging.

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: An extremely good experience every time I workout, with amazing coaches - Maahir, Sherlock, Ritika and Marwan and also the staff Ragini & Tayzun who make it so fun. Full of energy and motivation. I look forward to going back as often as I can for the music routine and super feeling while and after the workout.

featured_reviews.name: ruchi nanavaty
featured_reviews.review_text:
I usually attend OTF Yonge and Eglinton in Toronto, but during my recent 4-week trip to Bombay, I decided to keep up my fitness routine at OTF Kemps Corner. I was blown away by the positive vibes and exceptional hospitality here!
The admin team, especially Sheetal and Sushma, were always smiling and super helpful with all my requests—true superstars at the front desk. A special mention to Tayzun, who helped me set up my membership for 4 weeks, making the process seamless and welcoming.
The coaches—Ritika, Maahir, and Sherlock—were consistently full of energy, motivating me to push myself and achieve new personal bests.
Thanks to the entire team, I was able to complete nine awesome workouts while in the city. I look forward to seeing you all again in December!

featured_reviews.name: Alisha Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text: I absolutely love this gym! The group classes are top-notch, with knowledgeable and motivating instructors who push you to be your best. Each session is well-structured, engaging, and caters to all fitness levels, making it easy to stay consistent and see real progress. The energy in the classes is amazing, and the supportive community keeps me coming back for more. The facility is clean, well-equipped, and has a great atmosphere. If you’re looking for a gym that offers challenging and fun group workouts, this is the place to be!

featured_reviews.name: Kishore Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text: Time flies! It’s hard to believe that I’ve am already in my 3rd year at Orange Theory Kemps Corner. I’m grateful for the challenging worouts, supportive community, coaches, management and positive energy that I’ve found here…. I’m looking forward to many more years of fitness and fun. Special thanks to Sherlock, Tejas, Ritika, Marwan, Shreya, Ragini, Kenny, Aditya…..
